headlines.title: On the ground in Texas, Michigan and Maine: Voters speak out at polls on key Senate races
headlines.description: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz reports from Texas, Stephanie Gosk checks in from Michigan and Monica Alba has the latest from Maine on Election Day.

headlines.title: Photos: Celebration and gloom at watch parties across the U.S.
headlines.description: Joy and despair punctuated election watch parties overnight after a blue tsunami swept the country’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: 5 key insights from the NBC News Exit Poll about the blue tsunami
headlines.description: Voters expressed feeling fed up with the economy; Democratic candidates emerged more well-liked and Trump was resoundingly rejected.
headlines.source: Patrick J. Egan, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: Stocks surge as ‘blue tsunami’ puts political uncertainty to rest
headlines.description: Stocks rebounded after Democrats won key Senate races across the country. The size of the blue wave surprised Wall Street, which was expecting a ripple.

headlines.title: Trump Reacts to Midterm Results: ‘I Wasn’t on the Ballot’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has had a lot to say online and on the airwaves about the outcome of the midterm elections, including that he doesn’t view the results as a hit on him. “I don't like to consider it a defeat for me, I wasn’t on the ballot,” he said. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports and Hallie Jackson and Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker join TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Stocks surge as ‘blue tsunami’ puts political uncertainty to rest
headlines.description: Stocks rebounded after Democrats won key Senate races across the country. The size of the blue wave surprised Wall Street, which was expecting a ripple.

headlines.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan’s Senate race
headlines.description: NBC News projects that El-Sayed, a progressive former public health official, has defeated Republican Mike Rogers, a key victory for Democrats.

headlines.title: Record number of female governors elected
headlines.description: Voters in 15 states have elected female governors, setting a record as Democrats made sweeping gains in races up and down the ballot.

headlines.title: Democrat James Talarico turns Texas Senate seat blue, defeating Ken Paxton
headlines.description: Talarico has made history in Texas, notching a Democratic Senate victory there for the first time since 1988, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Tuesday’s elections bring historic first for Black governors
headlines.description: Wins by Byron Donalds in Florida, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia and Wes Moore in Maryland mean multiple Black governors will serve simultaneously for the first time.

headlines.title: Troy Jackson defeats GOP Sen. Susan Collins in Maine, padding Democrats’ majority
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Jackson, who became the Democratic nominee after an embattled Graham Platner dropped out, flipped control of the Senate seat.

headlines.title: Democrat Annie Andrews defeats GOP Sen. Darline Graham in South Carolina, a major upset
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Graham failed to secure a full term after she was appointed to the seat held by her late brother.
